cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can repair last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each. We'll keep the sequence clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we start with listening. I'll note my responses instead of saying them. Please finish each point before we move on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you hold the pen. Mark every interruption; I'll keep my hands on the table. We'll correct the first mark before attempting the next point.
